papers.title: Structure and Dynamics of Daily Psychopathology in Ethnoracially Minoritized Youth: Links to Discrimination and Stress
papers.summary:
-  We classified 170 files: 2 data, 3 code, 33 documentation, 14 materials, 117 output, 1 unknown.
-  We found 2 tabular data files and extracted 67 columns from 1 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 2 study groups (ex1, ex2), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  1 tabular data file could not be read because it was not downloaded. This can happen for private repositories or failed downloads; you can also pass `local_path` to point at a local copy. We ran automated data-quality checks on 67 columns and found no issues. 2 of 2 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: A Multilevel Signal Detection Theory Approach to Unconscious Processing Research
papers.summary:
-  We classified 2151 files: 1825 data, 152 code, 36 documentation, 136 materials, 2 unknown.
-  We found 1825 tabular data files and extracted 26272 columns from 1810 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 8 study groups (ex1, ex1c, ex2, ex2a, ex2b, ex3, ex4, ex5), plus 4 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  6 tabular data files could not be read because they were not downloaded. This can happen for private repositories or failed downloads; you can also pass `local_path` to point at a local copy.
-  2 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (UCC26 (2014).zip/UCC26 (2014)/26c/Analyses/Discard 10 Ss from BoothG data before analysis.txt: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; UCC26 (2014).zip/UCC26 (2014)/26c/Discard 10 Ss from BoothG data before analysis.txt: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: UCC26 (2014).zip/UCC26 (2014)/26c/Analyses/Discard 10 Ss from BoothG data before analysis.txt, UCC26 (2014).zip/UCC26 (2014)/26c/Discard 10 Ss from BoothG data before analysis.txt. We ran automated data-quality checks on 26272 columns; 1470 columns have at least one potential issue (882 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 289 columns whose values look like personal information; 142 columns whose names become identical when special characters are removed; 72 columns with numeric values stored as text; 72 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 47 columns whose name suggests personal information; 2 columns with leading/trailing whitespace). We detected demographic column for Gender. 5 of 5 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: What Is a “Blank” Mind? Testing the Meaning and Construct Validity of Mind-Blanking Reports to Thought Probes
papers.summary:
-  We classified 52 files: 41 data, 8 code, 3 documentation.
-  We found 41 tabular data files and extracted 1365 columns from 34 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 4 study groups (ex1a, ex1b, ex2, ex3), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  6 tabular data files could not be read because they were not downloaded. This can happen for private repositories or failed downloads; you can also pass `local_path` to point at a local copy.
-  1 file read as a table but is not a usable rectangular dataset (Reject.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: Reject.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1365 columns; 249 columns have at least one potential issue (154 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 40 columns whose name suggests personal information; 27 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 16 columns that look like geographic coordinates; 16 columns whose values look like personal information; 14 columns with numeric values stored as text; 8 columns with inconsistent category casing; 3 columns with leading/trailing whitespace; 2 columns whose names become identical when special characters are removed). We detected demographic columns for Gender, Race.

papers.title: Registered Replication Report and Extension of Maas & Hox (2005), Sufficient Sample Sizes for Multilevel Models
papers.summary:
-  We classified 81 files: 8 data, 34 code, 25 documentation, 14 materials.
-  We found 8 tabular data files and extracted 112 columns from 4 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  1 tabular data file could not be read because it was not downloaded. This can happen for private repositories or failed downloads; you can also pass `local_path` to point at a local copy. We ran automated data-quality checks on 112 columns; 25 columns have at least one potential issue (12 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 6 columns with inconsistent category casing; 6 columns with numeric values stored as text; 2 columns with leading/trailing whitespace; 1 column of free text that may contain personal detail; 1 column whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long). 1 of 3 spreadsheet files has at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: Mapping Altered Temporality: Human-Validated LLM Analysis of Naturalistic Trip Reports
papers.summary:
-  We classified 211 files: 46 data, 100 code, 50 documentation, 9 materials, 6 unknown.
-  We found 3 tabular data files and extracted 51 columns from 3 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 12 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata). We ran automated data-quality checks on 51 columns; 11 columns have at least one potential issue (7 columns with inconsistent category casing; 6 columns of free text that may contain personal detail; 2 columns whose values look like personal information; 1 column with leading/trailing whitespace).
